summary: Wrote an eight-phase plan for task 136's coverage measurement series and extraction-scope decision. Premise re-validation found the research report's central blocker already resolved: commit 2b713bf migrated programs.sapience to the Anthropic backend (claude-haiku-4-5), one real 50-chunk pass has since completed (29min 4s, 1208 objects staged, zero errors), and every figure in reports/02 is superseded, so the plan reframes the task's chunk-cap question against the constraints that actually bind now -- the 2000-objects/day cap, a 1208-deep unreviewed queue, and per-call cost on the user's Anthropic key. The plan is one phase per extraction pass (five passes, each gated on 24 hours' spacing) feeding a single ledger, then a read-only vault-content audit, then the decision, then a conditional enactment phase. Phase 1 is runnable immediately; the series legitimately spans at least seven calendar days and several /orchestrate invocations.
